summary: Opening a calculated dataset is faster: when the reserving class is unchanged since its last index rebuild, the open trusts the saved state instead of re-validating every upstream dependency file.
details: Because dependent updates now run as a single locked ArcRho Engine job, a current sidecar status plus an unchanged folder signature is trustworthy evidence of currency.
Any doubt (review-needed status, changed folder, missing index) falls back to the previous deep per-dependency validation.
